name: k12_mg1655_n500
key_challenge: Read-count sweep point (500 reads) to measure amortization of the fixed plan/index cost

simulation.notes: Same seed and parameters as T9a: reads are generated sequentially, so this set is an exact prefix (or, for 10,000, a superset) of T9a's reads.

truth.simulated: reads_1.fq.truth.tsv beside the reads: read_id chrom true_start strand true_end n_subs n_ins n_del indel_events. true_start is the 0-based leftmost reference coordinate; true_end is half-open. Score placement within +/-100 bp (long_read_accuracy.py).

benchmark_notes: Run phraya and minimap2 at all four read counts (100/500/2000/10000) and compare wall-time growth, not absolute time.
